title: The Necklace
synopsis: A story about a beautiful woman who believes she deserves better.

fullText.simplified:
对于漂亮的姑娘，上天仿佛并不慈爱，常常让她们出生在一个普通的家庭里。
    我们现在要说的这位姑娘——贾聪就是这样。她漂亮，身边有不少追求者，但总是没有十全十美的。足够认真的，她觉得都配不上她：要么不够聪明、要么太穷；她看得上的，却总是追一追就离开了，不够认真。让她伤心的是，她找不到一个有钱人认识她，然后爱上她，和她结婚、养她。最后，她只好嫁给了一个广告公司的普通员工。
    丈夫徐来虽说不是追求者中最好的，家庭普通，工作不求上进，还爱抽烟，但总算是养得起她，也拿她当宝贝看待。
    过不上豪华的生活，贾聪是普通的，这让她很不开心。因为她觉得自己本就是为了豪华事物而生的。她的人生太普通了：虽然结婚前丈夫的父母帮他们买了房子，但却是贷款买的，现在还有将近三十年的贷款要还；虽说没有车贷，但她却总因为自己家里的车不是豪车而觉得面上无光；虽说丈夫给她的钱不少，但并不够她在高级商场里想买就买……这些都让她无比难过。她总是觉得自己有美貌，却得不到应有的生活。当然，她算是过上了丈夫赚钱养家，自己貌美如花的生活。她不需要出去工作，这对于她来说，也算是不幸中的万幸了。
    贾聪每天的生活都很简单。她会抽空出入高级商场，想象着那些漂亮的名牌服装穿在自己身上的样子。如果看到商场有促销，她就会马上去买一两件来满足一下自己。更多的时候，她都是带着失望的心情去做美容，期待着有一天自己的美貌能让自己过上想要的生活。回家的路上，每当她看到那些去参加超市促销活动的人们，都会觉得又鄙视又庆幸：鄙视他们为了小钱而计较的样子，又庆幸自己和他们不同。但她又马上觉得很委屈，委屈自己竟然需要和这样的人做比较。
    她想象着，在那些高级商场里，两个高级柜员跟在她身后，让她痛快地购物；在那些豪华的酒店里，她每天都能睡到自然醒，然后再跟朋友一起去购物中心购物。这才是配得上自己美貌的优雅生活啊！
    然而，她并没有能够散步的衣帽间，当然也没有能装满衣帽间的名牌服装，更没有限量款的鞋和包，什么都没有……
fullText.traditional:
對於漂亮的姑娘，上天彷彿並不慈愛，常常讓她們出生在一個普通的家庭裡。
    我們現在要說的這位姑娘——賈聰就是這樣。她漂亮，身邊有不少追求者，但總是沒有十全十美的。足夠認真的，她覺得都配不上她：要麼不夠聰明、要麼太窮；她看得上的，卻總是追一追就離開了，不夠認真。讓她傷心的是，她找不到一個有錢人認識她，然後愛上她，和她結婚、養她。最後，她只好嫁給了一個廣告公司的普通員工。
    丈夫徐来雖說不是追求者中最好的，家庭普通，工作不求上進，還愛抽煙，但總算是養得起她，也拿她當寶貝看待。
    過不上豪華的生活，賈聰是普通的，這讓她很不開心。因為她覺得自己本就是為了豪華事物而生的。她的人生太普通了：雖然結婚前丈夫的父母幫他們買了房子，但卻是貸款買的，現在還有將近三十年的貸款要還；雖說沒有車貸，但她卻總因為自己家裡的車不是豪車而覺得面上無光；雖說丈夫給她的錢不少，但並不夠她在高級商場裡想買就買……這些都讓她無比難過。她總是覺得自己有美貌，卻得不到應有的生活。當然，她算是過上了丈夫賺錢養家，自己貌美如花的生活。她不需要出去工作，這對於她來說，也算是不幸中的萬幸了。
    賈聰每天的生活都很簡單。她會抽空出入高級商場，想像著那些漂亮的名牌服裝穿在自己身上的樣子。如果看到商場有促銷，她就會馬上去買一兩件來滿足一下自己。更多的時候，她都是帶著失望的心情去做美容，期待著有一天自己的美貌能讓自己過上想要的生活。回家的路上，每當她看到那些去參加超市促銷活動的人們，都會覺得又鄙視又慶幸：鄙視他們為了小錢而計較的樣子，又慶幸自己和他們不同。但她又馬上覺得很委屈，委屈自己竟然需要和這樣的人做比較。
    她想像著，在那些高級商場裡，兩個高級櫃員跟在她身後，讓她痛快地購物；在那些豪華的酒店裡，她每天都能睡到自然醒，然後再跟朋友一起去購物中心購物。這才是配得上自己美貌的優雅生活啊！
    然而，她並沒有能夠散步的衣帽間，當然也沒有能裝滿衣帽間的名牌服裝，更沒有限量款的鞋和包，什麼都沒有……

sentences.traditional: 這才是配得上自己美貌的優雅生活啊！
sentences.pinyin: zhè cái shì pèi de shàng zì jǐ měi mào de yōu yǎ shēng huó a
sentences.english: This was the type of refined lifestyle that her good looks deserved!

sentences.simplified: 然而，她并没有能够散步的衣帽间，
sentences.traditional: 然而，她並沒有能夠散步的衣帽間，
sentences.pinyin: rán ér tā bìng méi yǒu néng gòu sàn bù de yī mào jiān
sentences.english: Yet, she didn’t have a closet that she could walk around in.

sentences.simplified: 当然也没有能装满衣帽间的名牌服装，
sentences.traditional: 當然也沒有能裝滿衣帽間的名牌服裝，
sentences.pinyin: dāng rán yě méi yǒu néng zhuāng mǎn yī mào jiān de míng pái fú zhuāng
sentences.english: And of course she didn’t have luxury brand clothes to completely fill her closet, ..

sentences.simplified: 更没有限量款的鞋和包，什么都没有……
sentences.traditional: 更沒有限量款的鞋和包，什麼都沒有……
sentences.pinyin: gèng méi yǒu xiàn liáng kuǎn de xié hé bāo shén me dōu méi yǒu
sentences.english: .. not to mention limited edition shoes and handbags; she didn’t have anything …

sentence_translations: It seems that God is not kind to pretty girls, often allowing them to be born into ordinary families.
The girl we’re talking about now, Jia Cong, was like this.
She was very pretty and had quite a few suitors, but none of them were absolutely perfect.
She felt that those who were serious enough weren’t good enough for her.
Either they weren’t smart enough, or they were too poor.
The ones that she did approve of, however, were interested briefly and then vanished. They weren’t serious enough.
What made her sad was that she was unable find a rich person to get to know her, fall in love with her, marry her, and take care of her.
In the end, she had no choice but to marry an ordinary employee of an advertising company.
Although her husband Xu Lai wasn’t the best among the suitors, ..
.. he came from an ordinary family, he wasn’t motivated in his career, and he liked to smoke, ..
.. at the end of the day he had the means to take care of her, and he treated her like a treasure.
Unable to live a lavish lifestyle, Jia Cong was an ordinary person, and this upset her.
This is because she always felt that she was obviously born for luxurious things.
Her life was way too ordinary. Though before marriage her in-laws helped them purchase a house, ..
.. it was bought with a loan, and even now they have nearly thirty years of debt to pay off.
Though they didn’t take out a loan for the car, she always felt ashamed that their family car wasn’t a luxury one.
Though her husband gave her a good amount of money, ..
.. it wasn’t enough for her to buy whatever she wanted at high-end shopping malls …
All of this made her terribly upset.
She always felt that she was good looking, yet was unable to obtain the life that she deserved.
Of course, she essentially lived a lifestyle where her husband provided for the family and she could just look pretty.
She didn’t need to work, and for her, this was considered the best part of a bad situation.
Jia Cong’s everyday life was quite simple.
She would make time to go to high-end shopping malls, ..
.. imagining what all those pretty, designer clothing items would look like on her.
If she saw that the mall was having a sale, she would immediately buy one or two items to satisfy her cravings a little.
More often, she would go for beauty treatment feeling disappointed, ..
.. hoping that one day her good looks would allow her to live the life she wanted.
On the way home, whenever she saw people participating in supermarket sales, she felt both contempt and rejoicing.
Contempt that they were bothering about small amounts of money, yet rejoicing that she wasn’t like them.
But then she would immediately feel wronged that she had to go so far as to compare herself to these kinds of people.
In her imagination, she would be at a high-end mall with two high-end attendants following her around , ..
.. letting her shop to her heart’s content.
Or she’d be at those luxury hotels, sleeping in for as long as she likes, ..
.. and then going shopping at the mall with her friends.
This was the type of refined lifestyle that her good looks deserved!
Yet, she didn’t have a closet that she could walk around in.
And of course she didn’t have luxury brand clothes to completely fill her closet, ..
.. not to mention limited edition shoes and handbags; she didn’t have anything …
